finding.title: The code uses `new` to allocate memory for `i2c_dev`, but it does not check if the allocation was successful.
The code does not handle errors that might occur during I2C communication.
The code does not ensure that resources are properly released if an error occurs during initialization.
The `getCCStatus` and `getAttached` functions are similar and could be refactored to reduce code duplication.
